metadata.description: Sandgarden's coding-agent plugins for Cursor — gloria.dev, Miranda, Doc Holiday and Featurette.

plugins.name: gloria
plugins.description: Document a codebase's service dependencies and connect to the gloria.dev MCP server for health-check registration and status.

plugins.name: miranda
plugins.description: Track coding-agent token cost and attribute it to GitHub issues via Miranda, without installing the gloria plugin.

plugins.name: doc-holiday
plugins.description: Turn a documentation site map into ready-to-run Doc Holiday prompts, and drive Doc Holiday's documentation service via the gloria.dev MCP server.

plugins.name: featurette
plugins.description: Turn your website into videos of any kind (onboarding, support, product release, outreach), steer the director, and personalize per recipient through Featurette's MCP server.
